# 3a Routing module, schema, sources, services: contract

**Read first:** [build README → Phase 3](./README.md#phase-3-routing) (and its Phase 1 and 2 sections), [routing module](../modules/routing.md), [service management](../processes/routing/service-management.md), [domain sources](../integrations/domain-sources.md), [data model → Routing](../data-model.md#routing), [events → Routing](../events.md#routing), [ADR 0002](../adr/0002-modules-talk-through-ports-and-events.md), [ADR 0010](../adr/0010-router-contract-stays-mtvpn-compatible.md), [ADR 0013](../adr/0013-one-owner-service-per-domain.md), designs `RP-Services`, `RP-Service`, `RP-Custom-service`, and the **As built** of 2a (module wiring, `substest`, sortable lists, htmx answers that must re-render) and 1a (`store` style, `FieldErrors` with i18n keys). `~/projects/mikrotik/mtvpn.py` (outside the repo) is the tool this module replaces; where it and this contract differ, the contract wins.

**Done when:** the `routing` module is enabled after `subscriptions` and migrates the whole Phase 3 schema, with "Main" as the default list; selectors parse and get their tags without the network; v2fly (with includes and their attribute filters), iplist (portals in order, a miss told apart from an unreachable portal) and URL sources resolve into snapshots against `sourcestest`; upstream services can be added (a taken tag shows the existing service and offers **Switch source**, or another tag for a URL), switched and removed while in no list; custom services can be created and edited in the domain editor (table, **Paste many** with its normalisation report, suffix or exact, notes, names absorbed under a suffix) and their tag renamed; the Services list and the service page (overview, domains with a filter, skipped entries, snapshot history with diffs) work; every checklist line has its test.

Not in 3a: list contents, ownership and the guard (3b: "Main" exists but stays empty, the service page's "in lists" says "in no list", Add service has no list choice yet); refresh, **Accept anyway**, the catalog (3c); targets (3d onward). Every change point already calls the marker (`change.None` until 3e).

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Module | Name `routing`. `routing.New(p Ports) *Module`. In 3a it implements `Module`, `Initializer`, `EventDeclarer`, `SettingsDeclarer`, `MessagesDeclarer`, `RouteDeclarer`, `NavDeclarer`, `Searcher`, `SubjectNamer`. Later: `JobDeclarer`, `NotificationRenderer`, `SettingsPageDeclarer` (3c), `DashboardDeclarer` (3f), `IntegrationDeclarer` (3g). `Init` builds the services with `Now: func() time.Time { return m.Now() }` and `Marker: m`: the module itself implements `change.Marker` by forwarding each call to its field `m.Marker` (`change.None{}` until 3e's `Init` sets the routers' marker), so services built before the routers still reach it. | Build README → Phase 3 layout. |
| Wiring | `cmd/proxier/main.go`: `rt := routing.New(routing.Ports{Hostnames: srv.ServerHostnames(), Catalog: srv.EndpointCatalog(), Dialer: srv.ProxyDialer()})`; `return []module.Module{srv, subs, rt}`. 3b adds `srv.SetRouting(rt.Guard())`. | ADR 0002: ports through `main.go`. |
| Imports | `TestImportsOnlyServersPorts` (subscriptions' test as the model): non-test files under `internal/modules/routing` import from `internal/modules/servers` only the root package. | Build README rule "Ports only". |
| Upstream endpoints | `Module.Endpoints sources.Endpoints` (exported; `sources.Production()` by default) holds every base URL: v2fly raw files, the GitHub API, codeload, the three iplist portals in order. Tests set it to `sourcestest`'s before `platform.Open`. | Build README "Outbound HTTP". |
| Main | The migration inserts the list "Main" with `is_default = 1`. It records no event: it exists from the first start. | routing-lists.md step 1. |
| Selector grammar | `selector.Parse(s)`, after trimming: (1) `^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*)=([a-z][a-z0-9+.-]*://.+)$` (any case) is a **named URL** with tag `lower($1)`; (2) anything containing `://` is a **URL** (`http` or `https` only, a host required: `selector.ErrBadURL`); (3) no `:` at all is a **bare** name, meaning `v2fly:<lower(name)>`; (4) `v2fly:<name>` and `iplist:[<portal>:]<sel>` with any case in the prefix and the rest lowercased; a second `:` after `iplist:` must name a portal (`main`, `beta`, `russia`, else `ErrUnknownPortal`); (5) any other prefix is `ErrUnknownSource` ("unknown source 'foo'"). Names: v2fly `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._!-]{0,62}` (v2fly has `geolocation-!cn`), iplist `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,252}` (sites are domains or dotless names like `copilot`), else `ErrBadName`. `Selector.String()` is the stored spelling: `v2fly:anthropic`, `iplist:youtube.com`, `iplist:beta:apple`, the URL as typed, `mine=` + the URL. | domain-sources.md#selector-grammar; mtvpn's `parse_selector`. |
| Tags | `Selector.Tag()` without the network: v2fly and bare → the name; iplist → the site or group; named URL → its tag; a URL with `site=` or `group=` in its query → that value, lowercased; any other URL → its last path segment (after a trailing `/` is trimmed), lowercased and **not** unescaped, minus one of `.txt .list .lst .dat .conf .md` when something remains, or the host when there is no path. `selector.ValidTag(t)`: `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._!-]{0,62}$` and not `telegram-cidr` (the charset already excludes `mtvpn:`). A URL whose tag fails is refused with "Can't make a tag from this URL: name it, like mine=https://…" (`ErrBadTag`). Tags are unique across services (`UNIQUE`). | domain-sources.md#tags; RouterOS comments are written in double quotes, where `$`, `\` and `"` are special. |
| iplist storage | An **unpinned** iplist selector is stored as typed when it resolved on `main` (the first portal), and **pinned** to the portal it resolved on otherwise (`iplist:beta:apple`). The tag doesn't change. The snapshot records the portal and whether it was a site or a group. | service-management.md edge case "it's on main, so iplist:youtube.com"; a later refresh can't silently switch portals. |
| v2fly format | `sources.ParseList(text) (List, error)`, line by line: `#` starts a comment anywhere; blank lines skipped; the first field is the rule, later fields are attributes (`@ads`, `@-cn` filters on an `include:`) and affiliations (`&list`, ignored). `domain:x` and plain `x` are suffix, `full:x` exact, `regexp:` and `keyword:` skipped ("not supported on RouterOS"), `include:x` an include with its filter. Names are lowercased; one failing `^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?(\.[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$` or longer than 253 characters is skipped ("not a valid domain name"). Every entry keeps its attributes. | domain-sources.md#v2fly; v2fly's README. |
| Includes | Resolution of a list = its own entries plus, for each `include:x @a @-b`, the entries of x (resolved the same way, memoised per list, cycles ignored) that carry every `@a` and no `@-b` (the user's decision: filters honoured). An include is fetched relative to the list: `Endpoints.V2flyRaw + x` for v2fly, the URL's directory + `x` for a URL list. A failing include (any HTTP error, `404` included) fails the whole resolve: `include:geolocation-cn: HTTP 404`. At most 300 lists and 16 MiB per resolve (`sources.ErrTooBig`). Skipped entries of included lists are reported too. | upstream-refresh.md "a partial v2fly result is never accepted". |
| v2fly resolve | `GET Endpoints.V2flyRaw + name`. `404` → `sources.ErrNotFound` ("v2fly has no list 'nosuchlist'", with a link to search from 3c). Any other non-`200` → `*sources.HTTPError`. | service-management.md step 4. |
| iplist resolve | Portals in `Endpoints.Portals` order, or only the pinned one. On each portal: `?format=text&data=domains&wildcard=1&site=<sel>`, then `&group=<sel>` (site first: the shape doesn't tell them apart). A `200` whose body has a non-space character is **found** (its lines are suffix names; invalid lines are skipped); an empty `200` is a **miss**; a transport error, a timeout or any non-`200` makes the portal **unreachable**, and it isn't asked again in this resolve. Not found anywhere and every portal in scope answered → `ErrNotFound` ("not found on main, beta, russia"). Not found and some unreachable → `*sources.UnreachableError{Missed, Unreachable}` ("not found on main, russia; beta unreachable"). | domain-sources.md#iplist; "an unreachable portal is never 'not found'". |
| URL resolve | `GET` the URL (`http`/`https`, redirects followed up to 5, 8 MiB cap), body in v2fly format, includes relative to its directory. Any non-`200` → `*sources.HTTPError`. | domain-sources.md#url. |
| Empty first snapshot | Adding a selector whose resolve leaves no name at all is refused: "v2fly:x has no names RouterOS can use (3 skipped)". | A service that can install nothing is a mistake. |
| Snapshot sets | `snapshot.New(suffix, exact, skipped)` sorts, removes duplicates and removes from `exact` every name that is also suffix. Nothing else: an upstream service keeps names under its own suffixes (mtvpn compatibility, Build README defaults). `Set.Hash()` = SHA-256 hex of `"s " + name + "\n"` for each suffix name then `"e " + name + "\n"` for each exact one. Stored as text (Tables). | Build README "Snapshots are text". |
| Normalising | `domain.Normalise(s) (Name, error)` for what the admin types: trim; drop a trailing `#` comment; lowercase; `domain:` → suffix, `full:` → exact; `regexp:`, `keyword:`, `include:` → `ErrUnsupported`; a URL (`scheme://`) → its host; else strip userinfo, path, query, fragment, port and a trailing dot; a leading `*.` → suffix of the rest; an IPv4 or IPv6 address (also in brackets) → `ErrIP` ("an IP address: services hold domains only"); IDN → punycode with `golang.org/x/net/idna` (`idna.Lookup.ToASCII`), keeping the Unicode form for display; then the domain-name check (`ErrInvalid`). Plain names are suffix. | service-management.md step 3. |
| Custom domains | A custom service's editable rows are `routing_custom_domains` (domain, exact, note ≤ 200). Saving merges duplicates (suffix wins over exact), then **absorbs** every row covered by another suffix row of the same service (`example.com` suffix absorbs `full:api.example.com` and suffix `cdn.example.com`), each absorbed name reported "under example.com". At most 5 000 rows (`services.err.too_many`). | service-management.md "a suffix entry absorbs exact entries under it, with a note". |
| Add (upstream) | `services.Add(ctx, sel string, actor) (id int64, err error)`: parse → tag (no network) → **tag taken** → `*services.TagTakenError{Existing}` (nothing resolved) → resolve (outside any transaction, the interactive deadline) → one `Write`: insert the service, its first snapshot as **accepted**, `routing.service_added{selector, tag, source}`. 3b adds a list choice (`AddOptions.Lists`). | service-management.md steps 1–5. |
| Tag taken | The add page then shows the existing service (tag, selector, source, its lists). When the new selector **equals** the existing one: "anthropic already exists" with **Open anthropic**. Otherwise **Switch anthropic to iplist:claude.ai** (posts to the switch action) and, for a URL, a field "or name it" prefilled `<tag>-2=<url>` that adds a separate service. | service-management.md step 3. |
| Switch source | `services.Switch(ctx, id, sel, actor)`: upstream only (`ErrCustom`); the new selector's tag must equal the service's (`*services.SwitchTagError{Want, Got}`: "A switch keeps the tag: iplist:claude.ai has tag claude.ai, not anthropic"); the same selector → nothing changes and nothing is recorded; a selector that resolves to no usable name is refused (`ErrEmptyResolve`), as for Add. Resolve, then one `Write`: the selector and source change; when the resolved hash differs from the accepted snapshot, it becomes the accepted snapshot (the old one `superseded`) without the safety checks (the admin chose the source); `routing.service_updated{changes: "source", from, to}`; marker `Change{Services: [id]}` when the snapshot changed. | service-management.md "Switch source". |
| Custom create | `services.CreateCustom(ctx, Custom{Name, Tag, Description}, actor)`: name trimmed 1–60 (unique among custom services' names), tag empty → `selector.Slug(name)` (ASCII letters and digits kept, every other run becomes `-`, trimmed, ≤ 63; empty → the field error "type a tag"), `ValidTag`, free; description ≤ 1 000. It starts with no domains: an empty accepted snapshot (an empty custom service installs nothing). `routing.service_added{selector: "", tag, source: custom, origin}`. Then the editor opens. | service-management.md "custom services". |
| Custom save | `services.SaveCustom(ctx, id, Edit{Name, Tag, Description, Rows}, actor) (Saved, error)`: everything is checked first (`store.FieldErrors`; a row's error names its line); then one `Write`: rows replaced, a new accepted snapshot when the hash changed, the tag renamed when it changed (`ValidTag`, free: `services.err.tag_taken`), `routing.service_updated{changes, added, removed, from, to}` (`changes` of `name, tag, description, domains`; `from`/`to` the tags on a rename); marker `Change{Services: [id]}` when the snapshot or the tag changed. Nothing changed → nothing recorded. 3b adds the guard check here. | service-management.md step 5; "a rename makes every router replace the old tag". |
| Editor | `RP-Custom-service`: Name, Tag ("routers install it under this tag"), Description, the **Domains · N** table (domain shown with its Unicode form, **suffix**/**exact** radios, note, ×), **Paste many** (a textarea, "One per line. URLs, `*.`, `domain:` and `full:` are understood.") with **Preview** and **Add N to the table**, the report ("+12 added · 2 merged · 1 refused", then each merged, punycode and refused line), **Save N domains** (primary, `⌘↵`) and **Cancel**. The whole editor is one form that round-trips its state: **Preview**, **Add to the table** and × are submit buttons with `name="op"` that re-render the editor (htmx swaps it; without JS the page reloads with the same state); only **Save** writes. Unsaved new rows carry the `+` marker. | The template editor's rule: the form works without JS. |
| Remove | `services.Remove(ctx, id, actor)`: refused while any list holds it (`*services.InListsError{Lists}`: "Take it out of Main first", with links). Deletes the service, its snapshots and custom rows (`ON DELETE CASCADE`); `routing.service_removed{selector, tag}`. Strength 2: "Remove anthropic? Its snapshot history goes too. It is in no routing list, so no router or config changes." | service-management.md "Remove". |
| Services list | `RP-Services`: title block "Services", status line "28 services · 3 custom" (3c adds "refreshed daily at 04:00 · 1 snapshot waiting · 1 failing"), **Add service…** (primary, `n`) and **New custom service**. Filter bar (in the URL): source (all, v2fly, iplist, url, custom); 3b adds list and the chip "Not in any list · N"; 3c adds state. Columns: service (tag; under it the selector, or "custom" / "custom · from Discover"), source, domains (suffix + exact), refreshed ("added 8 Oct" until 3c; "saved 3 Oct" for custom), state ("ok" until 3c), lists ("none" until 3b). Sorted by tag. 50 per page with `ui.Pager`. Rows `data-row`, `data-href`. | modules/routing.md#pages. |
| Service page | `RP-Service`: crumbs, the tag, a status marker and word, the line "v2fly:netflix · tag netflix · in no list" (3b: "in Main and Parents"), primary action **Edit domains** (custom) or nothing in 3a (3c adds **Refresh now**). Areas in this DOM order: **Domains · accepted snapshot** ("212 · 198 suffix, 14 exact · 3 skipped"; a filter box (`?q=`, contains, any case, htmx); rows: name (and its Unicode form), suffix or exact, note ("under netflix.com" for a name under one of the service's own suffixes; 3b adds "owned by … in …"); 50 per page, `?page=`); **Skipped** (entry and reason); **Source** (selector, source, portal and site/group for iplist, created, last accepted with its count; 3c adds last check and errors; 3b adds lists with positions); **Snapshots** (time, state, count, `+added −removed`, a link to its diff); **Actions** (Switch source… for upstream; Edit domains for custom; Remove…), **Activity** (the last 10 events of `service:<id>`). | ui/README service page. |
| Snapshot diff | `GET /routing/services/:id/snapshots/:snap`: the snapshot against the accepted snapshot before it (the first one against nothing): counts, then the added names (`+`, foam) and removed names (`−`, love), each marked suffix or exact, 500 at most per side with "… N more". | "snapshot history with diffs". |
| Search, names, nav | Nav: **Services** `/routing/services`, group `routing`, order 20 (no go-to key). `Searcher`: services by tag, selector or name (contains, any case): label = tag, meta "service · v2fly · 9 domains", href = the page. `SubjectNamer`: `service` → tag (`/routing/services/<id>`), `routing_list` → name (`/routing/lists/<id>`, the page arrives in 3b), `routing` → `refresh` "Upstream refresh" (`/routing/services`), `catalog` "Catalog" (`/routing/search`). | Build README subjects. |
| Settings section | Registered in 3a with every key (the page arrives in 3c), in the leaf `routing/conf`: see below. | |
| Events | Every Phase 3 type is declared now (table below), so later sub-phases only record. Each has `event.<type>`; the notifying ones `notify.<type>` and `.body`. | 1a's and 2a's pattern. |

Settings section `routing` (`routing/conf`):

| Key | Kind | Default | Bounds, notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `routing.refresh_at` | string | `04:00` | `HH:MM` (validated); the daily refresh round in the display time zone (3c) |
| `routing.catalog_at` | string | `04:30` | `HH:MM`; the daily catalog refresh (3c) |
| `routing.shrink_min` | int | `20` | 1–100 000; the shrink check applies to accepted snapshots of at least this many names (3c) |
| `routing.shrink_pct` | int | `50` | 1–99; a refresh losing more than this percent of the names is rejected (3c) |
| `routing.github_token` | secret | `` | optional; sent to `api.github.com` when set, raising its limit (3c) |
| `routing.sync_delay` | duration | `30s` | 0 s – 10 min; how long a change waits for more before its router sync (3e) |
| `routing.drift_every` | duration | `6h0m0s` | 1 h – 168 h; the drift check (3f) |
| `routing.drift_repair` | bool | `true` | a drift check that finds drift queues a sync; off: it notifies instead (3f) |

## Tables

`internal/modules/routing/migrations/00001_routing.sql`: every Phase 3 table. Times are `db.Time` text. Ids of other modules' things are plain integers (ADR 0002). Comments name the sub-phase that first writes a table.

```sql
-- +goose Up

-- A service: a named set of domains from one source. Its tag is its identity
-- on routers (comment=) and in Shadowrocket (# tag).
CREATE TABLE routing_services (
    id               INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    tag              TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    source           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('v2fly','iplist','url','custom')),
    selector         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',      -- the stored spelling; '' for custom
    name             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',      -- custom: its display name; '' upstream (the tag names it)
    description      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    origin           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (origin IN ('','discovery','import','router')),
    last_checked_at  TEXT,                          -- the last refresh that got an answer (3c)
    last_error       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',      -- the last refresh's error; '' after a success (3c)
    failures         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,    -- consecutive failed refreshes (3c)
    failing_notified INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failing_notified IN (0,1)), -- refresh_failing sent for this run (3c)
    created_at       TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((source = 'custom') = (selector = ''))
) STRICT;

-- What a service held at a moment. Exactly one accepted snapshot per service:
-- the one targets get. Names are text, sorted and "\n"-joined.
CREATE TABLE routing_snapshots (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    service_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    status       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('accepted','superseded','rejected')),
    selector     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- what it was fetched from; '' custom
    portal       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- iplist: main, beta, russia
    kind         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- iplist: site or group
    suffix       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    exact        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- never a name that is also suffix
    skipped      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',        -- JSON [{"entry":…,"reason":…}]
    suffix_count INTEGER NOT NULL,
    exact_count  INTEGER NOT NULL,
    hash         TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- snapshot.Set.Hash()
    added        INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,        -- against the accepted snapshot it was compared with
    removed      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    reason       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- rejected (3c): 'empty' or 'shrink'; kept when accepted anyway
    lost_pct     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,        -- rejected for shrink: the percent lost
    forced_by    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- accepted anyway (3c): the actor
    in_round     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (in_round IN (0,1)), -- made by the daily round (3c)
    dismissed_at TEXT,                              -- rejected and dismissed (3c)
    fetched_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    accepted_at  TEXT,                              -- when it became the accepted one
    CHECK (status <> 'rejected' OR reason <> ''),
    CHECK (dismissed_at IS NULL OR status = 'rejected'),
    CHECK ((status = 'rejected') = (accepted_at IS NULL))
) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX routing_snapshots_accepted ON routing_snapshots(service_id) WHERE status = 'accepted';
CREATE INDEX routing_snapshots_service ON routing_snapshots(service_id, id);

-- The editable domains of a custom service. Each save also writes a snapshot.
CREATE TABLE routing_custom_domains (
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_services(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    domain     TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- normalised, punycode
    exact      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (exact IN (0,1)),
    note       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    PRIMARY KEY (service_id, domain)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE routing_lists (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name        TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    is_default  INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_default IN (0,1)),
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX routing_lists_one_default ON routing_lists(is_default) WHERE is_default = 1;
INSERT INTO routing_lists (name, description, is_default, created_at)
    VALUES ('Main', '', 1, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'));

-- The services of a list, in order (3b). A service in a list can't be deleted.
CREATE TABLE routing_list_services (
    list_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_lists(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    service_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_services(id),
    position   INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- 1..n, dense, rewritten on every change
    added_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (list_id, service_id)
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX routing_list_services_service ON routing_list_services(service_id);

-- The catalog (3c). Each source writes its rows as a new generation and then
-- switches to it; only a source's current generation is read.
CREATE TABLE routing_catalog_sources (
    source        TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (source IN ('v2fly','iplist:main','iplist:beta','iplist:russia')),
    generation    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- in force; 0 = never refreshed
    refreshed_at  TEXT,                             -- when the generation in force was made
    revision      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',         -- v2fly: the commit
    entries       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failures      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,       -- consecutive failed refreshes
    failing_since TEXT,
    last_error    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    notified      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (notified IN (0,1)) -- catalog_refresh_failed sent for this run
) STRICT;
INSERT INTO routing_catalog_sources (source) VALUES ('v2fly'), ('iplist:main'), ('iplist:beta'), ('iplist:russia');

-- What search finds: v2fly lists, iplist sites and groups.
CREATE TABLE routing_catalog_entries (
    source     TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('list','site','group')),
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- the list, site or group: its tag
    grp        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',            -- a site's group
    sites      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- a group's sites
    domains    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- names, includes resolved
    PRIMARY KEY (source, generation, kind, name)
) STRICT;

-- The reverse index: the list or site that holds a name directly.
CREATE TABLE routing_catalog_domains (
    source     TEXT NOT NULL,
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- the v2fly list or the iplist site
    domain     TEXT NOT NULL,
    exact      INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (exact IN (0,1)),
    attrs      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''             -- v2fly: the entry's attributes, "@ads @cn"
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX routing_catalog_domains_domain ON routing_catalog_domains(domain);
CREATE INDEX routing_catalog_domains_generation ON routing_catalog_domains(source, generation);

-- v2fly includes, so a lookup can name the lists that hold a name through one.
CREATE TABLE routing_catalog_includes (
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL,
    list       TEXT NOT NULL,
    included   TEXT NOT NULL,
    filter     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',            -- "@ads", "@-!cn", '' for none
    PRIMARY KEY (generation, list, included, filter)
) STRICT;

-- A MikroTik router (3e).
CREATE TABLE routing_routers (
    id                 INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name               TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    list_id            INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_lists(id),
    state              TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('awaiting','active','paused','removing')),
    host               TEXT NOT NULL,
    port               INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 22 CHECK (port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),
    ssh_user           TEXT NOT NULL,
    jump_host          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    jump_port          INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 22 CHECK (jump_port BETWEEN 1 AND 65535),
    jump_user          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    tailnet            INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (tailnet IN (0,1)), -- the first hop goes through the tailnet node
    address_list       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'to_vpn_list',
    doh_forwarder      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'vpn-doh',
    version            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    board              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    connected_at       TEXT,                        -- the first successful connection
    last_seen_at       TEXT,
    last_sync_at       TEXT,
    last_sync_result   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (last_sync_result IN ('','synced','failed')),
    last_sync_error    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    failures           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- consecutive failed sync attempts
    failure_notified   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (failure_notified IN (0,1)), -- a given-up sync notified since the last success (3e)
    drift              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- tags that drifted at the last check, comma-joined (3f)
    drift_checked_at   TEXT,
    unmanaged_notified TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',    -- unmanaged tags already notified, comma-joined (3f)
    untagged           INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- at the last read
    infra_pins         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,  -- at the last read
    read_at            TEXT,
    awaiting_until     TEXT,                        -- awaiting setup: probed until then (3f)
    created_by         TEXT NOT NULL,               -- admin; routerscripts (Phase 4)
    created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((jump_host = '') = (jump_user = '')),
    CHECK ((state = 'awaiting') = (awaiting_until IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT;

-- What Proxier last installed on a router, per tag (3e).
CREATE TABLE routing_router_tags (
    router_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_routers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag        TEXT NOT NULL,
    hash       TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- routeros.EntriesHash of the applied entries
    suffix     INTEGER NOT NULL,
    exact      INTEGER NOT NULL,
    applied_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (router_id, tag)
) STRICT;

-- Tags on a router that Proxier never installed (3f).
CREATE TABLE routing_router_unmanaged (
    router_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_routers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    tag        TEXT NOT NULL,
    entries    INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- DNS entries with that comment
    names      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',          -- JSON [{"name":…,"exact":…}], at most 5 000
    first_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_seen  TEXT NOT NULL,
    ignored_at TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (router_id, tag)
) STRICT;

-- Syncs, previews, drift checks and removals of a router (3e, 3f).
CREATE TABLE routing_syncs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    router_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_routers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    job_id      INTEGER,                            -- by value
    kind        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('sync','preview','drift','removal')),
    trigger     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- sync: change, manual, initial, drift, resume, list, unmanaged
    state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running','done','failed','cancelled')),
    step        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- failed: connect, read, push, verify
    hop         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (hop IN ('','tailnet','jump','router')), -- failed at connect: the hop (3e)
    error       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    read_at     TEXT,
    plan        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',         -- JSON: routers.TagPlan rows, without their names
    script      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- preview: what a sync would push (at most 4 MiB)
    added       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,         -- tags installed that weren't there
    updated     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    removed     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    unchanged   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    recorded    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,         -- unchanged tags recorded as applied for the first time
    drift       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- drift check: the tags that differ
    started_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX routing_syncs_router ON routing_syncs(router_id, id);
CREATE INDEX routing_syncs_job ON routing_syncs(job_id);

-- Test connection runs, of a saved router or of the add form (3e).
CREATE TABLE routing_tests (
    id              INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    router_id       INTEGER REFERENCES routing_routers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, -- NULL: the add form
    form            TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- JSON routers.Connection: what was tested
    job_id          INTEGER,
    state           TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('running','passed','warned','failed','confirm')),
    checks          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',     -- JSON [{"name":…,"ok":…,"detail":…}]
    confirm_hop     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' CHECK (confirm_hop IN ('','jump','router')),
    confirm_address TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    confirm_key     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',       -- authorized_keys form of the key to pin
    confirm_fp      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    version         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    board           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    error           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at     TEXT,
    CHECK ((state = 'confirm') = (confirm_hop <> ''))
) STRICT;

-- A hosted Shadowrocket config (3d).
CREATE TABLE routing_shadowrocket (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    name          TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,             -- also the file name: <name>.conf
    list_id       INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_lists(id),
    policy        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROXY',
    token         BLOB NOT NULL,                    -- vault "shadowrocket:<id>:token"
    token_lookup  BLOB NOT NULL UNIQUE,             -- vault.Lookup(token)
    enabled       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0,1)),
    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_fetch_at TEXT,
    last_fetch_ua TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE routing_shadowrocket_versions (
    config_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_shadowrocket(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    number     INTEGER NOT NULL,                    -- 1, 2, …
    content    TEXT NOT NULL,
    note       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (config_id, number)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE routing_shadowrocket_fetches (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    config_id  INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_shadowrocket(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    at         TEXT NOT NULL,
    ip         TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_agent TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''             -- at most 256 characters
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX routing_shadowrocket_fetches_config ON routing_shadowrocket_fetches(config_id, at);
CREATE INDEX routing_shadowrocket_fetches_at ON routing_shadowrocket_fetches(at);

-- An mtvpn import: its preview, then its result (3d). Never the file's text.
CREATE TABLE routing_imports (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    state        TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('preview','running','done','failed')),
    list_id      INTEGER REFERENCES routing_lists(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    rows         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',        -- JSON mtvpn.Row: selector, tag, from, status, choice, then outcome
    ignored      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- the ignored keys' names, comma-joined
    base         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',          -- the fetched shadowrocket_base
    base_url     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    shadowrocket TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',        -- JSON: the config choice, then its outcome
    job_id       INTEGER,
    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at  TEXT
) STRICT;

-- Discovery (3g).
CREATE TABLE routing_discovery_runs (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    input       TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- as typed
    url         TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- what is visited
    host        TEXT NOT NULL,
    registrable TEXT NOT NULL,
    via         TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (via IN ('direct','server','auto')),
    server_id   INTEGER,                            -- the servers module's id, no foreign key
    server_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    depth       INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (depth IN (0,5)),
    state       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','done','failed')),
    job_id      INTEGER,
    title       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    suggestions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',         -- JSON catalog.Suggestion
    visits      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',         -- JSON discovery.VisitRecord
    capped      INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (capped IN (0,1)),
    error       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at  TEXT NOT NULL,
    finished_at TEXT,
    CHECK (via <> 'server' OR server_id IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT;

CREATE TABLE routing_discovered_hosts (
    run_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES routing_discovery_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    host        TEXT NOT NULL,                      -- a hostname or an IP literal
    registrable TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- '' for an IP literal
    class       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (class IN ('first-party','cdn','tracker','third-party','ip')),
    requests    INTEGER NOT NULL,
    failed      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- the failure on the direct visit; '' none
    seen        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',           -- the visits that saw it: "direct, nl-1"
    PRIMARY KEY (run_id, host)
) STRICT;

-- +goose Down
DROP TABLE routing_discovered_hosts;
DROP TABLE routing_discovery_runs;
DROP TABLE routing_imports;
DROP TABLE routing_shadowrocket_fetches;
DROP TABLE routing_shadowrocket_versions;
DROP TABLE routing_shadowrocket;
DROP TABLE routing_tests;
DROP TABLE routing_syncs;
DROP TABLE routing_router_unmanaged;
DROP TABLE routing_router_tags;
DROP TABLE routing_routers;
DROP TABLE routing_catalog_includes;
DROP TABLE routing_catalog_domains;
DROP TABLE routing_catalog_entries;
DROP TABLE routing_catalog_sources;
DROP TABLE routing_list_services;
DROP TABLE routing_lists;
DROP TABLE routing_custom_domains;
DROP TABLE routing_snapshots;
DROP TABLE routing_services;
```

## Go signatures

### `routing` (root)

```go
// Ports are what the module uses of the servers module. A nil one hides its features.
type Ports struct {
	Hostnames servers.ServerHostnames // the guard (3b)
	Catalog   servers.EndpointCatalog // discovery's server picker (3g)
	Dialer    servers.ProxyDialer     // discovery through a server (3g)
}
type Module struct {
	Now       func() time.Time  // the module's clock; tests replace it
	Endpoints sources.Endpoints // upstream base URLs; tests replace them before Open
	Marker    change.Marker     // change.None{} until 3e; the module forwards to it
	Services  *services.Service
	// Lists (3b), Refresh, Catalog (3c), Shadowrocket, Import (3d), Routers (3e), Discovery (3g)
}
func New(p Ports) *Module
// Mark forwards to m.Marker as it is at call time.
func (m *Module) Mark(ctx context.Context, tx *sqlx.Tx, c change.Change) error
```

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /routing/services` | Services list (`?source=`, `?page=`) |
| `GET /routing/services/add`, `POST /routing/services` | Add service (`selector`) → the service page, or the add page showing the taken tag |
| `GET /routing/services/new`, `POST /routing/services/custom` | New custom service → its editor |
| `GET /routing/services/:id` | Service page |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/domains` | Domains fragment (`?q=`, `?page=`) |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/edit`, `POST /routing/services/:id/edit` | Domain editor (`op=preview\|add\|remove-<n>\|save`) |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/switch`, `POST /routing/services/:id/switch` | Switch source (`selector`) |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/snapshots/:snap` | Snapshot diff |
| `GET /routing/services/:id/remove`, `POST /routing/services/:id/remove` | Remove → `/routing/services` |

## Events

Declare every Phase 3 type now (`Module: "routing"`). Recorded in 3a: `routing.service_added`, `routing.service_updated`, `routing.service_removed`.

| Type | Notify | Emoji | Subject | Payload |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `routing.service_added` | off | | service | `selector` (`""` custom), `tag`, `source`, `origin` |
| `routing.service_updated` | off | | service | `changes` (of `source, name, tag, description, domains`), `from`, `to` (selectors for a switch, tags for a rename), `added`, `removed` (name counts of a custom save) |
| `routing.service_removed` | off | | service | `selector`, `tag` |
| `routing.snapshot_accepted` | off (the digest carries it) | | service | `added`, `removed`, `suffix`, `exact`, `forced`, `in_round` (3c) |
| `routing.snapshot_rejected` | **on** outside the round (`NotifyIf: !in_round`) | 🟡 | service | `reason`, `old_count`, `new_count`, `lost_pct`, `in_round` (3c) |
| `routing.snapshot_dismissed` | off | | service | `new_count`, `automatic` (true when a refresh equal to the accepted snapshot ended it) (3c) — **new** |
| `routing.refresh_failing` | **on** | 🔴 | service | `failures`, `error` (3c) |
| `routing.refresh_digest` | **on** when `changed + rejected + failing > 0` (`failing`: started failing this round) | 📋 | `routing:refresh` | `changed`, `added`, `removed`, `rejected`, `failing`, `still_failing`, `services` (changed tags) (3c) — **new** |
| `routing.catalog_refreshed` | off | | `routing:catalog` | `v2fly`, `iplist_main`, `iplist_beta`, `iplist_russia` (entries; `-1` for a source that failed) (3c) |
| `routing.catalog_refresh_failed` | **on** | 🔴 | `routing:catalog` | `source`, `error`, `since` (3c) |
| `routing.list_created` | off | | routing_list | `name` (3b) |
| `routing.list_updated` | off | | routing_list | `added`, `removed` (tags), `reordered`, `changes` (of `name, description, default`) (3b) |
| `routing.list_deleted` | off | | routing_list | `name`, `moved` (target names) (3b) |
| `routing.list_refused_server_hostname` | off | | routing_list | `domain`, `server`, `hostname`, `service` (3b) |
| `routing.shadowrocket_created` | off | | shadowrocket | `name`, `list` (3d) |
| `routing.shadowrocket_updated` | off | | shadowrocket | `changes` (of `base, list, policy, token, disabled, enabled`), `version` (3d) |
| `routing.shadowrocket_deleted` | off | | shadowrocket | `name` (3d) — **new** |
| `routing.router_added` | off | | router | `list`, `host`, `by` (`admin` / `routerscripts`) (3e) |
| `routing.router_updated` | off | | router | `changes` (of `name, connection, names, list`), `from`, `to` (list names) (3e) — **new** |
| `routing.router_connected` | off | | router | `version`, `board` (3e) |
| `routing.router_synced` | off | | router | `added`, `updated`, `removed`, `recorded`, `trigger` (3e) |
| `routing.router_sync_failed` | **on** when the job gives up (`final`: its last attempt, or an error no retry fixes) | 🔴 | router | `step`, `error`, `consecutive`, `manual`, `attempt`, `final` (3e) |
| `routing.router_recovered` | **on** when a given-up failure was notified since the last success (`notified`) | 🟢 | router | `failures`, `notified` (3e) |
| `routing.router_paused`, `routing.router_resumed` | off | | router | — (3f) — **new** |
| `routing.router_removed` | off | | router | `name`, `cleaned` (3f) |
| `routing.drift_detected` | **on** when `repair` is false | 🟡 | router | `tags`, `repair` (3f) |
| `routing.unmanaged_tags_found` | **on** | 🟡 | router | `tags` (the new ones) (3f) |
| `routing.unmanaged_tag_ignored` | off | | router | `tag`, `ignored` (false when no longer ignored) (3f) — **new** |
| `routing.discovery_completed` | off | | discovery | `website`, `hosts`, `suggestions` (3g) |
| `routing.discovery_failed` | off | | discovery | `website`, `error` (3g) |

The texts of the notifying ones are written in 3c (refresh and catalog), 3e and 3f (routers).

## Pages

- **Services** (`RP-Services`): as in Decisions. Empty state: "A service is a named set of domains from one source: a v2fly list, an iplist site or group, a URL, or your own." with **Add service…** and **New custom service**.
- **Add service**: a page styled as a dialog: the selector field (placeholder `v2fly:anthropic`), the grammar in one help line ("v2fly:<list>, iplist:<site or group>, iplist:beta:<…>, https://…, or <tag>=https://… · a bare name means v2fly:"), **Add service** (primary). It answers in place: a parse error under the field (422), an upstream error under the field ("v2fly has no list 'nosuchlist'", "not found on main, russia; beta unreachable", "https://…: HTTP 404"), a taken tag (Decisions), or a redirect to the new service's page with the band "Added anthropic: 9 names."
- **New custom service**: name, tag (help "Routers install its names under this tag. Leave it empty to use the name."), description → the editor.
- **Domain editor** and **Service page** and **Snapshot diff**: as in Decisions. The phone layout comes from `app.css` (one column under 760 px).

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/integrations/domain-sources.md`: include filters are honoured (`include:x @a @-b`), attributes on plain entries are dropped, affiliations (`&list`) are ignored; names allow `!` in v2fly list names and tags; an unpinned iplist selector is stored pinned when found on a portal other than main; limits (300 lists, 16 MiB per resolve; 8 MiB per URL list); a selector resolving to no usable name can't be added.
- `docs/processes/routing/service-management.md`: the custom editor's absorption covers suffix rows under a suffix too; the paste rules (`regexp:`, `keyword:`, `include:` refused; comments ignored); **Switch source** accepts the new source's snapshot at once, without the safety checks; a custom service starts empty; adding a selector that resolves to nothing usable is refused.
- `docs/modules/routing.md`: tag rules (charset, length, `telegram-cidr`), custom services' origin, the stored iplist spelling.
- `docs/data-model.md#routing`: the columns as built (snapshot text columns and counts, custom rows, router fields, test runs, syncs, imports), the catalog generations.
- `docs/events.md#routing`: the payloads of the table above and the new types (`snapshot_dismissed`, `refresh_digest`, `shadowrocket_deleted`, `router_updated`, `router_paused`, `router_resumed`, `unmanaged_tag_ignored`).
- `docs/architecture.md#intended-code-layout`: the module's packages.
